notes.title: World of One - 4 years later...
notes.content:
[b]Hi, dear friends![/b]

We decided it would be unfair to leave our game where it currently is and forget about it.
So, we gathered our entire experience, your feedback, and our willingness to make this world a bit better and prepared this enormous patch for you!

It makes grim “World of one” more friendly. We uprooted many things that distract you from the journey and ruin the atmosphere. We removed a huge number of unfair cases which lead to unpredictable deaths or long paths from a checkpoint. Also, we have fixed a bunch of technical issues. And we keep working hard on making our project better. We will be glad to see old and new players on our planets!

[list]
[*] We redesigned the checkpoint system
[*] Interactable and quest objects are highlighted
[*] Improved our combat system. Now it is more engaging
[*] Boss-battles improved
[*] We’ve thrown away some clunky puzzles and changed the planets a bit
[*] We improved stability and performance
[/list]

tags.feature: - We redesigned the checkpoint system
- Interactable and quest objects are highlighted
- Improved our combat system. Now it is more engaging
- Boss-battles improved
- We’ve thrown away some clunky puzzles and changed the planets a bit
- We improved stability and performance

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29023662/6d95bcf6ceb567f496e1649c4f4a7de22fe08a74.png[/img]

Dear Friends, 
We are glad to tell you about the release of a new version of the game. Plenty of exciting changes are waiting for you in this update. They will make your experience more comfortable and enhance your sense of immersion into the grim atmosphere of World of One.

[list]
    [*]Second boss fight is now more dynamic
    [*]The third boss is now capable of doing many cool things
    [*]Many details and decorations are added to bring more life into the world of the game
    [*]Secret level was added. Sometimes coming home is not fun
    [*]Secret ending is added
    [*]Checkpoint system is now more convenient 
[/list]

World of One is welcoming brave travellers and explorers.
We are looking forward to hearing your feedback, comments and wishes!
